supply.condition: All low ground tiles are undeployable, making melee units useless, and the opposition is nearly entirely made up of Drones .
All deployable tiles are low ground that allows both melee and ranged units to be deployed upon, but the automatic DP generation rate is reduced to 1 DP every 3 seconds.

There are limited deployable tiles but holes are present. Guards can hold back enemies effectively due to their high HP and ATK. Specialists can be used to displace enemies into the holes/intercept dangerous ones/dealing with large groups/laying down traps on the remaining open low ground tiles.

The opposition is made up of ground enemies with high DEF and large numbers of Drones . Snipers can easily dispatch aerial units especially when deployed on the Anti-Air Runes . Casters have no problem in dealing with ground units due to their Arts damage.
The opposition is made up of enemies with high DEF and low/no RES.
A Poison Haze is present. Defenders can last longer due to their high HP. Medics can restore friendlies' HP.
The automatic DP generation is disabled but defeating an enemy generates 2 to 3 DP.

The opposition is initially made up of enemies with high MSPD and later on enemies with above-average stats. Vanguards can be deployed early to intercept enemies with the Medical Runes compensating their subpar HP. Supporters can stall enemies so others can easily dispatch them.
